rationale: Only survey-based Kosovo informality/cash-intensity series with documented methodology; recurring publisher worth standing monitoring.
Prolific Kosovo policy institute reprocessing BQK banking/payment data; fast-reacting publication feed.
Distinct central-bank working-paper series previewing payment/inclusion indicators; 403 is Cloudflare bot defence, not death.
Openly harvestable thesis repository with Albanian works containing original card/e-banking usage surveys.
Largest economics faculty but no consolidated thesis repository visible; value as a monitored surface unproven.
Public full-text thesis portal; Mitrovica-based work valuable for the north-Kosovo cash/dinar question.
Single peer-reviewed consumer survey on cash-to-cashless switch; one-off evidence plus author cluster to snowball.
One RePEc record for a Kosovo e-banking adoption article; evidence artefact, parent index covers discovery.
Searchable aggregator of Kosovo economics and central-bank working papers; efficient standing academic monitor.
Only sustained Serbian-language research actor on dinar cash flows and branch closures in Serb-majority municipalities.
Secondary think-tank feed touching e-government payments and digital-finance policy; in scope but thin.
Mostly governance/rule-of-law with only indirect grey-economy signal, and URL check failed; re-look later.
Useful snowballing surface for self-archived Kosovo payment studies, but registration/ToS-gated and not a signal producer.
Mine once for the handful of Kosovo informal-economy theses; RIT repository is not otherwise Kosovo-relevant.
Only regular official remittance split by delivery channel (MTO vs bank) — direct driver of cash and ATM demand.
Sole official window on euro cash supply, denomination mix and note processing in a unilaterally euroised economy.
Static regulation PDF defining cash-handling and recirculation rules; reference document, not a recurring feed.
Authoritative register enumerating all licensed payment, e-money and MTO institutions; mine for the actor map, re-pull on re-dating.
One-off AML transfer-information regulation shaping MTO onboarding cost and cash pay-out friction.
Landmark BQK cost-of-retail-payments study quantifying cash vs electronic cost; single artefact, URL failure is bot defence.
National retail payments strategy page carries official cash-reduction targets shaping ATM/POS demand; updates over time.
Western Union principal agent running Kosovo's largest non-bank cash pay-out and bill-payment network; location and tariff pages change.
Address-level agent locator giving an independent map of cash pay-out points; scrape terms need a check at collection.
State postal counter network competing with branches and MTO agents for cash transactions; structural payments actor.
Quarterly provider-level pricing for the dominant Germany-Kosovo corridor, split by cash pickup vs account.
Comparable remittance estimates and bilateral matrix for benchmarking BQK figures; programme archive is the durable asset.
Single survey report evidencing hand-carried cash dominance in remittance delivery, invisible in banking statistics.
